description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling 'ConnectionOpened' events in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence layer. It implements an event handler that updates the connection status to 'OPEN'.

classes.name: ConnectionOpenedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing EventStrategy to handle ConnectionOpened events by updating connection status to OPEN.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a ConnectionOpened event by setting the connection status to OPEN and returning the updated connection object.
